trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    boxes=[]
    for c in set(sum(grid,[]))-{0,3,9}:
        pts=[(r,k) for r in range(h) for k in range(w) if grid[r][k]==c]
        a,b=min(r for r,k in pts),max(r for r,k in pts)
        x,y=min(k for r,k in pts),max(k for r,k in pts)
        boxes.append((a,b,x,y,c))
    markers=[(r,k) for r in range(h) for k in range(w) if grid[r][k]==3]
    depth=0
    for r,k in markers:
        inside=[v for v in boxes if v[0]<=r<=v[1] and v[2]<=k<=v[3]]
        depth=len(inside)
        color=0
        if inside:
            a,b,x,y,color=min(inside,key=lambda v:(v[1]-v[0]+1)*(v[3]-v[2]+1))
            # A fully obscured innermost rectangle has no visible color.
            if a<r<b and x<k<y and all(grid[i][j]==3 for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(x+1,y)):
                depth+=1
                color=6
        out[r][k]=color
    for r in range(max(0,h-depth),h):
        out[r][w-1]=9
    return out
